title: EvoMuPlaytesterExecutorDecision
description: Fast Tactical Executor decision (hydrogen-l-tf-medium) running on dynamic/fallback steps. Executes one atomic step of the Parent Planner's delegated plan, self-corrects minor UI hiccups, or escalates anomalies/bugs back to the Parent Planner.

observation.description: Brief observation of the current UI state, state_diff, and progress along the delegated batch plan.

expectation_met.description: True if the previous action succeeded and updated the UI/game state as expected (or if this is step 1 of the batch, or if ok:false was a recoverable UI/input rejection without log_exceptions). False if the previous action succeeded (ok:true) yet caused a silent UI-state desync or game bug.

discrepancy_summary.description: If expectation_met is false, describe the exact UI or game mechanic discrepancy so the Parent Planner can diagnose and file a bug report. Empty string if expectation_met is true.

reasoning.description: How this action executes the current step of the Planner's delegated plan, how you are self-correcting a minor UI hiccup, or why you are escalating back to the Parent Planner.

batch_step_number.description: 1-based step index within the current delegated batch.

batch_status.description: 'continue' if more steps remain in the batch after this action; 'completed' if this action completes the Planner's delegated plan (or success_criteria are met); 'escalate' to immediately pause before executing an action and return control to the Parent Planner (hydrogen-l-tf-high / fallback) due to a bug, UI-state desync, or abort condition.

escalation_reason.description: If batch_status is 'escalate', explain why control is being returned to the Parent Planner (e.g. silent UI-state desync, exception, missing widget after retry, or abort condition). Empty string otherwise.
